issues.title: chore: two copies of parseDashboardTarget, one of them is load-bearing
RetryPolicy is declared and threaded onto Task.retryPolicy, but neither field is ever read
bug: goal.status, goal.complete and goal.list are each registered twice; the second silently shadows the first
fix: bare-id model autocomplete uses split('/')[1] and throws for multi-slash refs
